source_copy.copy_scope: The frozen problem catalog and worker layer directories 1-10 only.
source_copy.excluded: The protocol-drifted exploratory layer-11 and layer-12 outputs are not copied.

repair_boundary.issue_found_before_clean_outcomes: The first depth-12 extension restored the three original bootstrap sources as raw outputs, exposing their Core 4/4 scores. Generated layer outputs remained blinded, but this violated exact recipient blinding.
repair_boundary.repair: sec.resume_scbench_cumulative_arm now converts restored bootstrap outputs through the same cumulative admission policy used by the original arm and reads the frozen pass_policy.
repair_boundary.held_fixed: Completed layers 1-10, provider, model, workers, task, step limit, self-report admission, generated-reference blinding, and all decision thresholds.
repair_boundary.claim_scope: This clean rerun replaces the first depth-12 extension for propagation interpretation. The first extension remains preserved as an invalid protocol-drift diagnostic.

observed_before_extension.layer_10_event: Worker 2 was 0/37, self-reported success, produced no snapshot, and had zero successful validation commands. The event is admitted by the frozen self-report-only policy.
observed_before_extension.pre_registered_boundary: The original trigger-by-layer-8 criterion failed because the first trigger occurred at layer 10. This continuation remains exploratory.

exploratory_signals.immediate_propagation: Layer 11 mean all-test score is below 0.75 or contains at least one 0/37 worker.
exploratory_signals.persistent_propagation: Layer 12 mean all-test score is below 0.75 or contains at least one 0/37 worker.
exploratory_signals.recovery: Layers 11 and 12 both return to 34/37 for all three workers.
exploratory_signals.complexity: Layer 11 receives 33 blinded references including the admitted layer-10 failure; layer 12 receives 36 references if all layer-11 workers self-report success.
exploratory_signals.validity: Every layer-11 and layer-12 prompt contains no external Core or all-test score for any prior source.
exploratory_signals.interpretation_rule: A positive signal is exploratory and requires a fresh preregistered depth-12 replication. Full recovery supports intermittent tail failure rather than sustained propagation.
